name: table_supported_4dof_stl_v1
description: Four-axis manual reference derived from the current CAD STL meshes; physical setup pending validation

approach.physical_setup: Confirm the new bracket reference with the rebuilt arm before setting validated=true.

stl_constraints: The minimum world-Z vertex of link_2 arm_link.stl is tangent to the table plane defined by the minimum world-Z vertex of base_pair.stl.
The original joint_3 geometric reference is retained at 8.8698 degrees; its link_3 motor remains tangent to the table plane.
The fourth-axis mechanical zero is explicitly 0 degrees; tool orientation is reported but is not used as a zeroing constraint.
The tool_mount.stl clearance is checked against the table in this reference pose.
notes: The positive branch retains the original first-arm and link_3 motor table tangencies. joint_4 is held at the requested 0 degree mechanical zero.
Do not command the robot to this pose; place it manually while all motors are in BRAKE mode and the arm is supported.
This file contains geometric joint angles only. It does not establish encoder zeros, motor directions, or a valid power-cycle calibration.
